summary: All six blocks of the F3.2 adversarial recompute reproduce the declared values with independent code (13 checks + 1 extra counter-check, 0 numeric discrepancies). (1) 20/20 sampled census scalars equal the R package values exactly; 380 of 478 census values come from R2 areas or windows. (2) md5 and ETags of the 3 holdout files match the manifest; the P5 metrics file is a single-part upload, so its ETag is the plain md5. (3) The used-area counts and ids match R2 (30), R2b (24) and R5 (314). (4) P-1 per-area and per-tissue numbers match to <=4e-13 relative and 6/6 predictions are confermata. Extra counter-check: the 3.0.0 matrix has 18975 more features, 898 with counts. On the shared genes 3.0.0 has about 0.5% FEWER UMI, so the declared +0.9% is a net of two opposite effects; verdicts are unchanged. (5) Agreement 0.907 / kappa 0.882, L1 0.779, L2 0.255 and 48 kept areas are reproduced. (6) Size check 20/24, all 4 A4 cases hold; note that A6 M4 passes only trivially (all values 1.0, margin 0). Nothing was written to the repo or to /mnt/micron; scratch is in /tmp/f32rev and the job workdirs.
